Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results for Orestis Laskos. In Step 4, the Planner stated, "Birth year for Orestis Laskos appears to be 1964 (from Wikipedia/IMDb sources)." This is a factual error; the search results clearly showed Orestis Laskos was born in 1907 (died 1992), while 1964 was the release year of the film "Allos Gia To Ekatommyrio." This misattribution of the film's release year to the director's birth year led to an incorrect initial comparison, although the Planner later corrected this in Step 6.
